I hear how exhausted you are, and I want you to know that what you're feeling is real and valid. Depression doesn't care about age, and being unable to afford help doesn't make your struggle any less deserving of support. The fact that you've carried this alone for so long shows incredible strength, even if it doesn't feel that way.

There are low- and no-cost options that might help: many communities have sliding-scale or free counseling through organizations like NAMI, local health departments, or university training clinics. Crisis lines like 988 (call or text) are free, confidential, and available 24/7—you don't have to be in immediate crisis to reach out. Online support communities can also reduce the isolation of hiding how you feel. Please consider connecting with one of these resources soon; you shouldn't have to carry this alone.
